title: Energy Systems
description: Characteristics of energy systems: structure, currencies, energy sources, dynamics of energy systems, emissions trajectories. Technoeconomics: issues associated with the delivery of energy services such as sustainability, emissions, cost and energy intensity. Electrification and the role of storage: the grid, generation characteristics, mixtures, renewable supplies, impacts of variability, grid storage.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 542, MECH 447.
